1. Check the weather forecast for Brno for the weekend dates and note temperature, precipitation, wind, and any warnings.

3. Compile the final short packing list by combining all items from step 2 into a concise, organized list ready for the trip.

Results so far:

| Date | Temp (°C) | Precipitation (mm) | Wind (km/h) | Weather Notes / Warnings |
|------|-----------|--------------------|-------------|--------------------------|
| **2026‑11‑26** | –0.1 → 1.4 | 5.3 mm (moderate rain) | Up to 10.8 | Light rain expected, mild temperatures. |
| **2026‑11‑27** | –0.5 → 1.2 | 0 mm | Up to 12 | Mostly clear, cool overnight. |

No official weather warnings or advisories are in effect for the weekend. Temperatures will hover just above or below freezing, with light rain on Saturday. Wind will be moderate (≈10–12 km/h).

Now do step 2: Based on the forecast, list essential items to pack such as clothing, tent gear, food, safety supplies, and any weather-specific gear like rain jackets or extra blankets.

content.text:
**Step 2 – Essential Items to Pack (Based on Brno Weekend Forecast)**  

*Clothing & Personal Items*  
- Warm base layers (thermal tops & bottoms) – 2 sets  
- Insulated mid‑layer (fleece or down vest) – 1‑2 pieces  
- Waterproof/windproof jacket (with hood) – 1  
- Waterproof hiking pants – 1 pair  
- Warm hat, gloves, and scarf (or balaclava) – 1 set  
- Moisture‑wicking socks – 4 pairs (plus extras)  
- Comfortable hiking boots (water‑resistant) – 1 pair  
- Extra underwear & socks for wet conditions  
- Sunglasses & sunscreen (for bright, sunny mornings)  
- Personal toiletries (toothbrush, toothpaste, etc.)  
- Waterproof bag or dry sacks for electronics & valuables  

*Shelter & Sleeping*  
- Tent (with rainfly, or a waterproof tarp if the tent lacks one)  
- Ground tarp or footprint  
- Sleeping bag rated for 0 °C or colder  
- Sleeping pad (insulated, air or foam)  
- Pillow or packing foam pillow  

*Cooking & Food*  
- Portable stove & fuel canisters (check compatibility with local fuel)  
- Lighter & waterproof matches  
- Cookware set (pot, pan, kettle)  
- Eating utensils (spoon, fork, knife)  
- Reusable food containers & cooler (with ice packs)  
- Pre‑packed meals: freeze‑dry soups, pasta, rice, canned beans, high‑energy bars  
- Snacks: nuts, dried fruit, chocolate  
- Water bottles & a water filter/purification tablets  

*Safety & Navigation*  
- Fully charged mobile phone & portable charger  
- Headlamp or flashlight (extra batteries)  
- Map of the area & compass (or GPS device)  
- First‑aid kit (bandages, antiseptic, tweezers, pain relievers, blister treatment, allergy meds)  
- Multi‑tool or knife  
- Firestarter kit (wick, tinder, waterproof matches)  
- Whistle & emergency signal mirror  
- Emergency contact info & itinerary with a friend/relative  

*Weather‑Specific Gear*  
- Extra blankets or emergency thermal sleeping bags  
- Waterproof ponchos or extra rain jackets  
- Windbreaker layers for windy mornings  
- Hand & foot warmers (for chilly nights)  

*Miscellaneous*  
- Trash bags (Leave No Trace)  
- Small repair kit (duct tape, spare zippers, spare hooks)  
- Notebook & pen  
- Camera (if desired)  
- Small backpack or daypack for hikes  

These items cover the anticipated light rain, cold temperatures around freezing, and moderate wind for the weekend near Brno.

about.title: Plan and execute: a plan first, then the steps, with a weather forecast
about.author: Agent Atlas Academy
about.description:
A planner writes the steps and an executor does them one by one.

**What it teaches**

A plan made first gives the run a shape. The executor can call a tool: here the weather forecast, a fact no model can know.

**What to watch**

The steps of the plan, when the executor asks for the forecast, and how the list changes with it. The forecast is the one of the day of the recording.

Read more: [Plan and execute](#/learn/plan-and-execute)
